visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The screen is split into a decorative top frame featuring a highly detailed anime-style male character with dark, sweeping hair holding a light-colored flute, while the bottom frame displays a screen recording of a mobile MOBA game. The game environment is a lush, vibrant forest map with intricate terrain, foliage, and paths. (2) The player-controlled assassin character maneuvers quickly through the jungle area, using high-speed dashes that leave faint trails of light. Numerical damage values and health bars float above the character as they attack neutral monsters, with a yellow-tinted highlight appearing around the character's feet to indicate active status effects. (3) Combat intensifies as the player engages an enemy hero. Sharp purple eye graphics flash as a screen overlay during critical skill activations. The game character moves in rapid, zigzagging patterns, executing circular area-of-effect strikes that produce bright blue energy bursts and particles while subtitles scroll across the center. (4) Multiple enemy heroes join the fray, creating a dense visual scene filled with various character silhouettes, colorful skill indicators, and UI notifications. The player character performs a series of precise blink movements to dodge attacks, eventually resulting in an on-screen 'Double Kill' notification appearing in bold text. (5) The final phase shows a coordinated skirmish near an enemy structure. The player utilizes a decoy mechanic, leaving a static shadow behind before reappearing to deliver a finishing blow. The top anime character frame remains unchanged throughout, serving as a constant header for the high-intensity gameplay footage below.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm and articulate male voice begins a professional narrative commentary. The background music consists of a rhythmic, mid-tempo electronic beat with synthetic textures. Very soft ambient forest hums are audible, creating a base atmospheric layer. (2) Sudden 'whoosh' sounds and sharp metallic clinks trigger as combat commences. The narrator's tone becomes more energized, shifting his pitch to emphasize strategic moves. Each skill usage generates a distinct digital chime or resonant impact effect. (3) A loud, processed announcement of 'Double Kill' interrupts the main narrative. The SFX density increases with rapid-fire thudding and sparkling magical sounds. A Japanese vocal snippet ('Kamida') is clearly heard, marking a pivotal in-game moment. (4) The audio layers become hyper-dense as multiple character abilities activate simultaneously. Continuous percussive impacts and whooshing transitions dominate the mid-frequencies while the BGM maintains its driving rhythm underneath the fast-paced speech. (5) The narration reaches a high-arousal peak as the narrator describes a final finishing move. A resonant, booming sound effect marks the culmination of the fight, followed by the 'Dominating' announcer call and a final synthetic swell before the track fades.
